title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #19: Pecos, Toyah Basin, Monahans and Davis Mts., Texas
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#19" with a north arrow at upper left. Handwritten labels include "sand dunes", "U.S. 80", "Monahans", "Pecos R.", "Pecos", "Toyah Basin", "Ft. Stockton", "Apache Mts.", "Davis Mts." and "Rio Grande R.". Faint show-through handwriting appears in the upper right corner.
